function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a quick guide to the most popular styles, what they’re good for, and tips on choosing the right one for you. | Style | Key Features | Ideal Use | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|-----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; elastic waistband | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Good support
• Keeps everything in place
• Versatile | • Can feel tight if too small
• May show through tight pants | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug front | Work, casual, gym | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Less coverage
• Can feel restrictive | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, long leg | Sleep, lounging | • Breathable
• Comfortable | • Little support
• Can bunch up | | **Trunks** | Short leg, snug | Fashion, gym | • Modern look
• Good support | • Less coverage than briefs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch, minimal fabric | Sports, high‑impact activities | • Excellent support
• Minimal chafing | • Not for everyday wear | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight fit, high‑density fabric | Recovery, athletic performance | • Muscle support
• Reduces vibration | • Can feel restrictive if too tight | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor | Outdoor, travel, gym | • Keeps dry
• Odor control | • Usually pricier | | **Lace/Designer** | Decorative fabrics | Special occasions | • Stylish
• Unique | • Less practical for daily wear | --- ## How to Pick the Right One 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity**: Boxers or loose briefs for breathability. - **High activity**: Compression briefs or performance fabrics to reduce friction and keep you dry. 2. **Fit Matters Most** - **Waistband**: Should sit at the natural waist, not too tight or low. - **Front pouch**: Should support without digging. - **Length**: For briefs, the leg length should be comfortable; for boxers/trunks, the leg should not be too long or too short. 3. **Fabric Choice** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but can absorb sweat. - **Microfiber / Polyester blends**: Moisture‑wicking, quick‑dry. - **Bamboo / Modal**: Soft, eco‑friendly, good for sensitive skin. - **Spandex / Lycra**: Adds stretch and shape retention. 4. **Durability & Care** - Look for reinforced stitching at the waistband and seams. - Check washing instructions; some performance fabrics need cold water and no dryer. 5. **Style & Color** - Neutral colors (black, navy, gray) are versatile. - If you like a pop of color or pattern, choose a style that won’t show through your outerwear. --- ## Top Picks (2024) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Uniqlo** | Ultra Stretch Briefs | Affordable, breathable, great fit. | | **Calvin Klein** | Modern Briefs | Classic design, premium cotton. | | **Under Armour** | Tech 2.0 Compression | Moisture‑wicking, supportive. | | **Tommy John** | Second Skin Boxers | Ultra‑soft, no‑pouch design. | | **Saxx** | Saxx Vibe Trunks | Innovative pouch, breathable mesh. | | **Patagonia** | Capilene Performance | Eco‑friendly, moisture‑wicking. | | **Hanes** | ComfortSoft Boxers | Budget friendly, soft cotton. | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | *Do I need a pouch?* | For most men, a pouch provides support and reduces friction. If you’re prone to chafing, choose a pouch style. | | *Can I wear boxers under tight pants?* | They’ll show a bit; choose a low‑cut boxer or a boxer brief instead. | | *How often should I replace underwear?* | Every 3–6 months, or sooner if you notice wear or loss of elasticity. | | *What’s the best fabric for sensitive skin?* | Bamboo, modal, or high‑quality cotton blends. Avoid rough synthetic blends. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or classic briefs. - **For sports or travel**: Performance fabrics or compression briefs. - **For lounging or sleep**: Loose boxers or trunks. - **For style**: Trunks or designer options. Try a few styles from reputable brands, pay attention to fit and fabric, and you’ll find the “best” underwear that feels like a second skin. Happy shopping!
